method: Public primary-source web inspection; short paraphrases only; no vendor APK, firmware or restricted spec PDF downloaded.

sources.title: MIDI 1.0 Core Specifications
sources.observation: Public MIDI messages are specified independently of HyVibe. The specification text, implementation and logos have distinct rights questions.

sources.title: Standard MIDI Files Specification
sources.observation: Official SMF landing page and download listing; member/download access notices are present. Full downloadable document and its terms were not acquired.

sources.title: MIDI over Bluetooth Low Energy
sources.observation: Defines MIDI encoding over BLE; full download access is membership-labelled. It is a separate transport from the custom app GATT service.

sources.title: MIDI Association IP Policy
sources.observation: Members owning essential claims make royalty-free RAND licensing commitments subject to stated conditions including reciprocity. This is not a finding that every relevant patent is covered.

sources.title: MIDI 2.0 Logo Licensing Program
sources.observation: Explicitly distinguishes making MIDI 2.0 products from licensing its logo. It is not a substitute for checking applicable MIDI 1.0/BLE-MIDI document and mark terms.

sources.title: HyVibe MIDI instructions (French)
sources.observation: Vendor explains AirTurn pairing and bindings, Control Change and Note On; this documents an external-controller workflow, not a grant for private RPC implementation.

sources.title: HyVibe MIDI instructions entry
sources.observation: Links to https://www.hyvibeguitar.com/airturn-midi-instructions/. English linked page was also opened; detailed binding text was inspected on the French page.

sources.title: HyVibe Terms of Sale
sources.observation: Published update date 2021-10-20. Sales terms; Article 13 protects website elements. Article 10 addresses warranty exclusions. This is not affirmative developer permission.

sources.title: HyVibe Privacy Policy
sources.observation: Published effective date 2018-09-21. Covers website and app Service and refers to Terms and Conditions; privacy wording is not an interoperability license.

sources.title: JSON-RPC 2.0 Specification
sources.observation: Public spec requires string version 2.0 and permits implementation/use of document under its stated notice conditions; it does not define HyVibe methods or grant HyVibe rights. Parsed indexed URL was accessible after canonical fetch timeouts.

sources.title: Bluetooth qualification overview
sources.observation: SIG describes product qualification and patent/copyright/trademark agreements. Applicability to an OS-API-only desktop application needs a product-specific determination.

sources.title: Bluetooth QPRD v5
sources.observation: Version date 2026-04-21. Defines products/designs/layers and qualification requirements; no application-only exemption or fee conclusion established in this pass.

sources.title: Wireshark PacketLogger reader
sources.observation: Current upstream source declares GPL-2.0-or-later. Selected header/record and endian logic was inspected alongside Rust pklg reader. No exhaustive expression comparison or historical-source pin established.

sources.title: 17 USC 102, official 2024 edition
sources.observation: Section 102(b) excludes ideas/procedures/systems from copyright protection. This is not a blanket contract, patent or copying clearance.

sources.title: 17 USC 1201, official 2024 edition
sources.observation: Section 1201(f) is conditional, including lawful access, necessity, independent interoperability and limits on disclosure. No exemption determination made for this project.

sources.title: HyVibe feature overview
sources.observation: Advertises external PC input, Bluetooth speaker and MIDI controller capability. Feature support is distinct from licensing a private app protocol.

sources.title: HyVibe terms-and-conditions candidate URL
sources.observation: Not accessible through web tool in this audit. Historical founding note reported 404; no fresh HTTP status or proof that no terms exist elsewhere.
